verdict.rationale: Decagon offers some adjacent controls—technical teams retain 'visibility and control over guardrails, integrations, and versioning' and Simulations/testing validate agent behavior 'before deploying to production and with every subsequent update'—suggesting some change-management workflow exists, but there's no explicit documentation of version history browsing, diffing, review/approval workflows, or a rollback mechanism to a prior automation state. missing for 10: explicit versioning UI/history, review/approval workflow for changes, documented rollback mechanism, independent confirmation of these capabilities in use.
